scenarios.title: Extort drains one life when its controller casts a spell and pays {W/B}
decisions: A casts Shock targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain.
Extort triggers. On resolution A pays {W/B}, tapping Swamp.

variants.label: pays_extort
variants.expected: The extort trigger resolves: B loses 1 life (19) and A gains 1 life (21). Shock resolves and Grizzly Bears is destroyed.

variants.label: declines_extort
variants.delta: A chooses not to pay {W/B} when the extort trigger resolves.
variants.expected: The extort trigger resolves with no payment: life totals stay 20 and 20. Shock resolves and Grizzly Bears is destroyed. Swamp stays untapped.

variants.label: opponent_casts
variants.delta: A casts no spell; B casts its own Shock targeting A, tapping Mountain.
variants.expected: Basilica Screecher's extort does not trigger because its controller did not cast the spell. Shock resolves: A's life is 18, B's life is 20.

scenarios.title: Each instance of extort triggers separately
decisions: A casts Shock targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain.
Every extort trigger goes on the stack. As each resolves A pays {W/B}, tapping one Swamp each time.

variants.label: three_instances
variants.expected: Three extort triggers resolve separately: two from Basilica Screecher (its own and the one granted by Pontiff of Blight) and one from Pontiff of Blight. A pays three times: B loses 3 life (17) and A gains 3 life (23). Grizzly Bears is destroyed.

variants.label: one_instance
variants.delta: Pontiff of Blight is not on the battlefield, so Basilica Screecher has a single instance of extort.
variants.expected: One extort trigger resolves and A pays once: B loses 1 life (19) and A gains 1 life (21). Grizzly Bears is destroyed.

scenarios.forge_notes: Check that Forge keeps Basilica Screecher's printed Extort and the one granted by Pontiff of Blight as two separate triggers.
